GLD's own pool cost 1.1% at $1,000 today, over the bar; Thom kept gold listed (GOLD-LISTED). Universal Router 2.1.2 on this chain: V3_SWAP_EXACT_IN takes six fields, (recipient, amountIn, amountOutMin, path, payerIsUser, uint256[] minHopPriceX36), and reverts SliceOutOfBounds() with the classic five; pass an empty array. Read-only; nothing was sent.
